skill.displayName: Custom Bikini – Design & Try-On Personalized Swimwear Online – API-powered
skill.summary: Custom bikini — transform a person photo into a bikini model image or video

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the custom-bikini OpenAPI skill.
- Transforms a person photo into a bikini model image or video.
- Requires HTTPS access to openapi.weshop.ai and an API key set via the WESHOP_API_KEY environment variable.
- Supports uploading images, setting bikini scene descriptions, choosing output type (image or video), and batch generation.
- Includes secure API key handling instructions and endpoint documentation.
